noteEn: Making and sharing kimchi for the winter is called {ko:김장}. Neighbours make it together and share it. UNESCO inscribed Kimjang, making and sharing kimchi in the Republic of Korea, in 2013.

sources.title: Kimjang, making and sharing kimchi in the Republic of Korea

notes: Pass 1, author (content-skill): note, items and sources written from the cited pages, all accessed 2026-10-30; every claim is quoted in quoteOrLocator.

Pass 2, three checkers. Language: romanization of every item and token is the F-CNT-002 converter's output (checked by the build); polite 해요 register in the ko text; Pre-A1 English. Culture and facts: each claim matched to an allowlisted source (§6.6) with the §5.1 conventions. UNESCO status claimed only for the exact element under its UNESCO name in English and Spanish (the Spanish page's own title); the Korean note names the element as the Korea Heritage Service page does (김장문화) with its inscription sentence. 'Neighbours make it together and share it' restates UNESCO's 'communities collectively make and share' and 'exchanging kimchi among households'. Learning design: 5 items, at most 8 new (lesson-new-load), no two items of the drop said alike (dictation-unambiguous), no %, score, age word, speaking line or emoji (review-copy).

Pass 3, reviser and third pass: fixes of pass 2 applied (wording kept plain, every holiday and term date re-read against the KASI table), es and ko overlays re-read against the English; no copy claims native-speaker or expert review.
